description: This file defines the implementation of the VSSPath class, which handles conversion and manipulation of VSS paths in different formats (VSS, VSSGen1, JSON). It includes methods for parsing, converting, and generating path representations, and is part of a larger project related to VSS path handling.

classes.name: VSSPath
classes.description: Class for managing VSS path conversions between different formats and representations.

methods.name: VSSPath
methods.description: Constructor initializing VSSPath object with paths and JSON path.

methods.name: isGen1Origin
methods.description: Checks if the path is from a Gen1 origin.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Returns the path as a string, depending on origin.

methods.name: fromVSS
methods.description: Creates a VSSPath object from a VSS string.

methods.name: gen1togen2
methods.description: Converts a Gen1 path to Gen2 format.

methods.name: gen2togen1
methods.description: Converts a Gen2 path to Gen1 format.

methods.name: gen2tojson
methods.description: Converts a Gen2 path to a JSONPath string.

methods.name: jsontogen2
methods.description: Converts a JSONPath string back to Gen2 format.

methods.name: fromVSSGen2
methods.description: Creates a VSSPath object from a Gen2 path.

methods.name: fromVSSGen1
methods.description: Creates a VSSPath object from a Gen1 path.

methods.name: fromJSON
methods.description: Creates a VSSPath object from a JSONPath string, specifying if it's Gen1.
